calls.thesis: Looking to add, probably about double his 1,500-share position over the next couple of weeks before early-November earnings. Thesis: Alibaba's Qwen open-source model (captions: 'Qin') benefits as firms flee expensive closed frontier models — Chinese open-source models processed 76 trillion tokens in the week ended 27 Sep, up from 4.3 trillion in late April — and he expects that growth to show in the next report after a disappointing spending-heavy last report.
